Vertrauen im digitalen Zeitalter!Bei G+D schaffen wir Vertrauen durch integrierte Sicherheitstechnologien in drei Geschäftsbereichen: Digital Security, Financial Platforms und Currency Technology. Entdecken Sie unsere innovativen Lösungen für SecurityTech!The Proposal & Contract Manager plays a key role throughout the entire project lifecycle, from the initial bid phase through to contract execution and delivery. The position combines the strengths of a traditional Proposal Manager with the commercial responsibilities of a Commercial Project Manager, ensuring seamless end-to-end support and continuity for both the customer and the project team.In the proposal phase, the Proposal & Contract Manager is responsible for coordinating, developing and pricing competitive and sustainable offers. During project execution, the role takes ownership of the commercial aspects of the contract, ensuring that budgets, profitability targets and contractual commitments are successfully achieved.Acting as the commercial counterpart within the project, the Proposal & Contract Manager steers project-related commercial activities, safeguards adherence to budgetary guidelines and helps align customer expectations with Veridos' business objectives. The role contributes to successful project outcomes by balancing commercial performance, contractual compliance and customer satisfaction.To achieve this, the Proposal & Contract Manager works closely with a broad range of stakeholders across the organization, including Sales Managers, Project Managers, Service Level Managers, Commercial Order Managers and other key functions. Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder management skills are therefore essential for success in this position.Your Responsibilities- Lead and coordinate complex proposal processes from opportunity shaping through bid submission and contract handover.- Analyze customer requirements and develop commercially and technically viable solution approaches in collaboration with Sales, Customer Solutions and Business Lines.- Own commercial bid calculations, pricing models and business case development to ensure competitive, profitable and executable proposals.- Drive bid qualification activities, including risk assessments, resource planning and bid/no-bid recommendations.- Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders throughout the proposal lifecycle, ensuring quality, compliance and timely delivery.- Prepare and support management approval processes, including financial, cash flow and risk assessments.- Develop and maintain strong customer relationships during the bid and contract execution phases, acting as a trusted advisor on commercial and contractual matters.- Identify commercial risks and opportunities early and implement appropriate mitigation or optimization measures to support sustainable business growth.- Act as the commercial lead during the transition from bid phase to project execution, ensuring a seamless handover and contractual alignment.- Serve as the key contact for contractual and commercial matters throughout the project lifecycle.- Monitor commercial project performance, including budgets, profitability, receivables and risk mitigation measures.- Support contract negotiations, customer correspondence and commercial governance activities.- Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned, market insights and optimization of proposal and commercial management processes.- Foster collaboration across Sales, Customer Solutions, Business Lines, Project Management and other key stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.Your Qualifications- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management or a comparable qualification. Alternatively, equivalent professional experience.- Experience in Proposal Management, Bid Management, Commercial Project Management, Contract Management or a comparable customer-facing role.- Strong commercial, financial and analytical skills with experience in costing, pricing or business case development.- Ability to understand complex technical solutions and translate them into compelling customer proposals.- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international and cross-functional environment.- Ability to balance customer requirements, business objectives and operational feasibility.- Proactive, structured and solution-oriented working style with a high level of ownership and accountability.- Team player with the ability to lead virtual, multicultural and interdisciplinary teams.- Fluent English skills, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10-30%).

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) in Tübingen  as soon as possibleResearch Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track)(full time / part time)Location:TübingenEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options availableType of contract: The position is initially offered on a fixed-term basis. The type and duration of the contract will depend on the successful candidate’s individual qualifications and profile, as well as the applicable legal framework, and may not exceed six years. Subject to a positive evaluation, the position is intended to lead to a permanent appointment under the Senckenberg tenure track scheme.Remuneration:  collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13﻿The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) is based in Tübingen, Baden-Württemberg.Since 2009, our scientists in Tübingen have been conducting research on the biological and cultural evolution of humans in their environments in close cooperation with the Eberhard-Karls-University of Tübingen.Your Responsibilities- Developing, planning and conducting archaeogenetic and palaeogenetic research projects within the framework of the SHEP research programme in Tübingen- Analysing ancient human DNA, particularly from Eurasia, and reconstructing the evolutionary and population history of ancient human populations- Investigating population structures, kinship patterns and forms of social organisation through the integration of genomic, archaeological and historical data- Scientifically coordinating the generation of new genomic data in collaboration with project partners, and contributing to the development and enhancement of bioinformatic analysis pipelines- Publishing research findings in international peer-reviewed journals, developing research proposals and contributing to third-party funding acquisition- Establishing and maintaining national and international research collaborations, and working closely with research groups at SHEP and the University of Tübingen- Providing academic and professional supervision to staff, as well as supervising doctoral researchers and students- Undertaking organisational responsibilities and coordinating collaborative research activities within the research groupYour Profile- A completed PhD in Archaeogenetics, Evolutionary Biology, Molecular Anthropology, Population Genetics or a related natural science discipline- Strong expertise in the analysis and interpretation of genomic data, particularly ancient DNA, combined with excellent bioinformatic skills- Proven experience in integrating genomic data with archaeological, anthropological and historical evidence- Knowledge of approaches to reconstructing population structures, kinship relationships and forms of social organisation in past communities- Experience in developing and applying genomic or bioinformatic methods; jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Business Transformation Program Manager (f/m/d), you will partner with business and digital stakeholders across North America to assess current processes and drive the transition toward SAP S/4HANA-driven standardization. You will guide fit-to-template decisions, identifying opportunities to adopt global standards while addressing regional requirements and essential customization. Working closely with senior leaders, you will align stakeholders, lead cross-functional workstreams, and drive transformation through structured planning, effective communication, and strong change leadership.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead value stream mapping sessions to assess current processes, identify best practices, and evaluate alignment with future global templates* Guide fit-to-template decisions, determining where SAP S/4HANA standard solutions can be adopted, where regional extensions are required, and where customization is essential to ensure business continuity* Partner with Business and Finance Digital Transformation leaders to align transformation outcomes with strategic priorities and facilitate senior-level decision-making across a complex stakeholder landscape* Develop and deliver executive-level communications that clearly articulate transformation scope, rationale, benefits, and implications, ensuring stakeholder alignment and engagement* Lead multiple workstreams and cross-functional teams using a consulting-style delivery approach, while developing and executing change management strategies that drive adoption and sustainable engagement* Oversee rollout activities in close collaboration with business and IT stakeholders, ensuring structured planning, coordinated execution, and a seamless transition to the future SAP S/4HANA platform and operating modelWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Technology Management, Digital Transformation, or a related field* Extensive experience leading enterprise-level transformation programs, particularly SAP S/4HANA implementations or large-scale SAP modernization initiatives* Consulting or professional services experience at Manager or Engagement Lead level is strongly preferred* Deep expertise in business process analysis, value stream mapping, and fit-to-template transformation approaches, ideally in the context of SAP S/4HANA* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, change management, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and influence senior leaders* Willingness to travel up to 25% domestically and internationally; fluency in English and GermanAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
